 The AI Operations team is responsible for building, launching, and scaling AI-powered voice and Agentic AI solutions across Paytm s merchant ecosystem. 
 The team works closely with Business, Product, Technology, Data, QA, and Operations teams to drive AI-led automation across merchant engagement, retention, activation, support, and service journeys. 
 The team owns the complete operational lifecycle of AI campaigns - from use-case identification and conversational journey design to voice-bot creation, prompt development, testing, deployment, performance monitoring, and continuous optimization . 
 About the role: 
 We are looking for a Campaign Manager - AI Operations who will own the end-to-end execution and success of AI-powered voice and Agentic AI campaigns. 
 The role will involve creating AI voice agents, writing and optimizing prompts, designing conversational journeys, launching campaigns, monitoring performance, analyzing AI interactions, and continuously improving the agent to drive measurable business outcomes. 
 The candidate should have a strong combination of operations understanding, prompt engineering, conversational AI, analytical thinking, and execution skills . 
 Role Expectations/ Responsibilities: 
 AI Agent Creation: Build and configure AI voice agents for different merchant use cases by defining conversation journeys, agent behavior, business rules, objection handling, and closure logic. Prompt Engineering: Write, test, and continuously optimize production-ready prompts to ensure the AI agent follows the required conversation flow, understands merchant responses, asks relevant questions, handles objections, and drives the intended outcome. Conversational Journey Design: Translate business requirements and operational processes into structured AI conversations covering opening, intent identification, probing, resolution, objection handling, confirmation, and closure. Campaign Ownership: Own AI campaigns end-to-end, from understanding the business requirement and creating the AI agent to testing, launch, monitoring, and post-live optimization. Campaign Performance: Track and analyze campaign KPIs such as connect rate, successful outcome, retention, activation, conversion, AHT, FCR, drop-offs, retry effectiveness, and cost per successful outcome. AI Call Analysis: Review AI call recordings and transcripts to identify issues such as incorrect responses, repetition, hallucination, unnecessary probing, long monologues, missed objections, incorrect intent identification, and poor call closure. Prompt Agent Optimization: Convert call-level observations into actionable improvements in prompts, agent instructions, conversation flows, business logic, and tool usage. Agentic AI Optimization: Work on improving the agents ability to understand context, make appropriate decisions, use available tools, follow business rules, and complete the intended merchant journey autonomously. Quality Management: Partner with QA teams to define AI quality parameters, conduct regular audits, identify critical quality/compliance gaps, and implement corrective actions. Business Outcome Management: Ensure AI campaigns are optimized for measurable business outcomes and not only operational metrics such as call connectivity. A/B Testing Experimentation: Design and execute experiments across prompts, conversation flows, scripts, retry strategies, and campaign configurations to improve campaign performance. Production Monitoring: Closely monitor newly launched campaigns, identify issues early, and drive corrective actions to stabilize and scale campaigns. Data Analytics: Analyze campaign dashboards, call-level data, MIS, and AI performance trends to identify gaps and opportunities for improvement. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Product, Engineering, Data, QA, Business, and Operations teams to develop, launch, troubleshoot, and scale AI campaigns. Process Automation: Identify opportunities to automate campaign setup, reporting, ticket updates, retries, outcome capture, and other operational processes. Documentation Governance: Maintain campaign documentation including prompts, conversation flows, business rules, test cases, success metrics, changes, and deployment requirements. 
 Key Success Metrics: 
 The role will be measured across AI quality, campaign performance, business outcomes, and operational efficiency , including: 
 AI campaign connect rateSuccessful outcome / conversion rate Merchant retention and activation AI conversation quality score AHT and call efficiency FCR / successful resolution Prompt and AI agent performance improvement Reduction in hallucinations and critical compliance issues Retry effectiveness Cost per successful outcome Campaign launch timelines Automation and manual effort reduction

Operations Understanding: Strong understanding of contact-center operations, customer/merchant journeys, campaign management, and operational KPIs. Conversation Design: Ability to convert complex business requirements into simple, structured, and effective AI conversations. Analytical Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets. SQL and BI tools will be an advantage. Stakeholder Management: Ability to work with Product, Engineering, Data, QA, Business, and Operations teams to drive AI initiatives. Execution: Strong ownership and ability to manage multiple AI campaigns simultaneously from requirement gathering through production and optimization.
